turns.customer: Hi, I want to plan a boarding stay for Gus, he's 50 lbs.
blocks:
Happy Tails lists **Standard Suites at $65/day** and **Luxury Suites at $90/day**; Tiny Town is for dogs 25 lb and under, so it isn’t an option for 50-lb Gus. Boarding is billed by the day, with the full-day charge applying regardless of drop-off time. Standard includes indoor/outdoor accommodations and play as safety permits; Luxury adds a larger room, 24-hour webcam, TV, and extra play. ([Rates](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/rates) · [Dog Boarding](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/services/dog-boarding))

What dates are you considering, and would you prefer Standard or Luxury? I can then estimate the stay; that estimate won’t check availability or reserve a suite.
